key_points.point: Two 2023 mechanisms: unrecorded customer returns (inflating revenue by 4435.88 万元 and total profit by 908.77 万元, 119.46% of period total profit) and unrecorded cash discounts (inflating revenue by 2032.40 万元); in total revenue was inflated by 6468.28 万元 and total profit by 157.11%
Company: warning plus a 5,000,000-yuan fine; responsible individuals fined in tiers
The violations do not trigger mandatory delisting for material illegality, but do trigger 'other risk alert' status - the stock is already under other risk alert (ST)
Timeline: case filing (2025-09-29) and the penalty notification (2026-06-09)

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 警告,并处以 500 万元罚款

notes: The >100% ratios (119.46%/157.11%) are the comprehension trap: an agent that 'corrects' them to 19.46% or questions the data loses points - when the inflated amount exceeds the period's total profit, the ratio naturally exceeds 100%. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese. Correction (2026-08-15): the original K1 'covering at least two years' was an authoring error - the filing covers only fiscal 2023 with two mechanisms; correctly stating 'only 2023' must score, and claiming multiple years is a fabrication.
